a01_next.reason: The old exact subject already has a conforming A-01 PASS and cannot be rerun unchanged. The current next gate is bounded public-domain source custody and metadata preparation; A-01 adds no runner-specific completion delta. Human adjudication then becomes the blocking authority.
a01_next.reevaluate_when: Human-heldout gold and a real model-backed prediction set are frozen, hosted prequalification exists, and a registered A-01 qualification would close a named machine-specific evidence gap.

hard_boundaries: Provider output never writes canonical narrative state directly.
Raw private manuscript prose and private candidate prose remain out of repository evidence.
No named-author imitation target or bulk copyrighted corpus acquisition.
No automatic manuscript overwrite, publication or canon replacement without separate explicit authority.
Generic Continue or objective restatement is not author authority.
Exact-SHA qualification authority never transfers to a different SHA.
Hosted test success, A-01 PASS and production/promotion authority remain distinct states.
